## Delivery Objective

Correct the responsive presentation of the authenticated administrator Members page at `/admin/members`. Account-state tabs and pending counts must remain readable and separated, and member status and action controls must reflow without overlap, inaccessible controls, or horizontal page overflow.

## Acceptance Result

- The four existing state tabs remain distinct and usable across narrow, tablet, and desktop widths.
- `Pending Admin Acceptance (0)` and `Revoked Access` do not intrude into the member list or overlap other content.
- Member identity, status, Approve access, Revoke access, Restore access, and Change role remain visible, separated, focusable, and usable at the planned widths.
- Existing state filtering, counts, search, pagination, access transitions, role management, and administrator authorization remain unchanged.
- The change passes the acceptance matrix in `stages/matic/02-plan-control/acceptance-matrix.md`.

## Confirmed Boundary

- This is a contained presentation correction under `CHG-46 (Separate administrator member lists by account state)`.
- `D-69 (Should the administrator Members page separate users by account state?)` already authorizes the account-state views and preservation of existing behavior.
- `RQ-08 (The application must work on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices)` is the primary requirement.
- `RQ-09 (Administrators must approve, grant, revoke, and restore participant access)`, `RQ-10 (Protected routes, APIs, and files must enforce server-side access controls)`, and `RQ-15 (The application should support participant, moderator, and administrator permissions)` remain regression boundaries.
- The canonical source is `application/source/`, with the affected page at `application/source/resources/js/pages/admin/members/index.tsx`.
- The planned change has no database, route, API, storage, email, deployment, staging, or production effect.
